use_case_name: Clear Exercise Surveillance Data on an Exercise Status Order

claims.content: To clear exercise surveillance data on an Exercise Status Order.

goal.raw_text: To clear exercise surveillance data on an Exercise Status Order.

claims.content: C2 JU
The C2 JU has received or is processing a J7.0 Track Management (ACT = 6) Exercise Status Order message.
There exists at least one track with the Exercise Indicator set to value 1, Exercise Track, for which surveillance data is being maintained.
The system is capable of distinguishing artificial exercise data from non-artificial data as defined in paragraph 4.4.2.1.2.
A C2 JU issues a J7.0 Track Management (ACT = 6) Exercise Status Order message to clear exercise surveillance data.

trigger.raw_text: A C2 JU issues a J7.0 Track Management (ACT = 6) Exercise Status Order message to clear exercise surveillance data.

claims.content: The C2 JU receives or processes a J7.0 Track Management (ACT = 6) Exercise Status Order message.
For each track with the Exercise Indicator set to value 1, Exercise Track, the system identifies data concerning the track as artificial for exercise purposes.
The system clears the artificial data associated with the exercise track, ensuring that non-artificial data elements are preserved.

The system retains the following non-artificial data for the exercise track: Track Number; Tracking Data (Latitude, Longitude, Altitude/Elevation/Depth, Course, Speed, Minute, Hour, and Track Quality); Simulation Indicator; Environment/Category; Status Data on Air Tracks (Fuel Function, Fuel, Time Report Function, Minute, and Hour); and Status Data on Surface (Maritime) Tracks (Flight Deck Status, Landing/Approach Condition, and associated Time Report Function, Minute and Hour).
If the C2 JU attempts to transmit or process a J7.0 (ACT = 2) Change Data Order message containing an ID of Pending, the system shall not accept or transmit that order.

If a receiving JU does not implement the changed Environment/Category and holds R² on the track, it must cease reporting the track and transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) Drop Track Report message instead of processing the order.
Surveillance data concerning tracks with the Exercise Indicator set to value 1 (Exercise Track) is cleared or considered artificial.

The following specific data elements associated with the exercise track are retained and not treated as artificial: Track Number; Tracking Data (Latitude, Longitude, Altitude/Elevation/Depth, Course, Speed, Minute, Hour, and Track Quality); Simulation Indicator; Environment/Category; Status Data on Air Tracks (Fuel Function, Fuel, Time Report Function, Minute, and Hour); and Status Data on Surface (Maritime) Tracks (Flight Deck Status, Landing/Approach Condition, and associated Time Report Function, Minute and Hour).
